description: Generates a report for an ACTIVATE event from the intelligence; persists the concrete action plan the Visitor and bot have co-constructed and any commitment language. Called when the Visitor has moved from understanding to constructing plans for civic engagement.
name: campaignActivate

cid.description: The unique identifier of the campaign instance

report.description: My interpretation of the ACTIVATE event, including the co-constructed action plan, the Visitor's commitment, and any updated state fields

action_plan.description: The concrete plan co-constructed with the Visitor: one issue, one action type, one proximate step. Small and real; do not over-extend.

issue.description: The specific issue this action addresses, ex., 'reproductive rights', 'local school board representation'

action_type.description: The form of civic participation the Visitor is taking on

proximate_step.description: The small concrete next step — what the Visitor will actually do first, named in plain language

commitment.description: The Visitor's commitment language verbatim where given; empty string if no explicit intent was stated

affect_vector.description: The Visitor's transition from understanding to readiness for civic action

label.description: The label/description of the affect vector, ex., 'understood -> ready to act'

evidence.description: The evidence for the affect vector, such as 'the visitor named a specific action without prompting'

intensity.description: The intensity of the affect vector

distress_flags.description: Any noticed distress flags set by the visitor contact. Content that seems difficult for human; comma-delimited

hook.description: What's the most compelling argument for the visitor so far?

mood.description: What's the general mood of the visitor at this point?

stage.description: The stage of the visitor in the campaign process
